sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/mmrvpark (Campspot park 2718 availability API for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13, read in a browser 2026-10-22)

hookups.source: Campspot park 2718 site types ('FHU 30/50 Amp Big Rig Site', 'W/E 50 Amp Pull Thru RV Site'; amenities '50-Amp', 'Water Hook-Up', 'Sewer Hook-Up') + https://www.mmrvpark.com/rv-sites ('FHU sites', 'Water & Electric sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 56 wooded RV sites on 33 acres, plus four cabins, two rental RVs and five tent sites. 'We can accommodate rigs to 45' towing a car or truck' on long pull-throughs; Campspot lists site lengths 20-45 ft.

sites.source: https://www.mmrvpark.com/ ('56 isolated RV spots, four wooded cabins, two stationary RVs for rent, and five tent sites') + https://www.mmrvpark.com/faq ('on a nice, long pull-through site ... We can accommodate rigs to 45′ towing a car or truck') + Campspot site types (rvLengthMax 20-45), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Free hot showers; dump station free to patrons, or mobile pump-out Tue & Fri for a charge. Wi-Fi not guaranteed at every site; no cable. Gift shop; fenced dog park.

facilities.source: https://www.mmrvpark.com/rv-sites ('modern, up-to-date shower facilities', 'newly remodeled laundry room', 'The dump station is free to our patrons or a mobile pump-out service is available for a minimal charge on TUE & FRI', 'Complimentary Wi-Fi access is provided') + https://www.mmrvpark.com/faq, read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.mmrvpark.com/online-booking ('Mountain Meadow RV Park & Cabins now offers online booking through Campspot ... https://www.campspot.com/book/mmrvpark'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water & electric $75, full hookups $85, big-rig $95 a night plus taxes and fees. Campspot quotes the same three tiers for May and July 2027 at $83.25 / $93.55 / $103.88 a night with tax.

fees.source: https://www.mmrvpark.com/rv-sites ('BIG-RIG sites $95 / night +taxes & fees', 'FHU sites $85 / night + taxes & fees', 'Water & Electric sites $75 / night +taxes & fees'; undated) + Campspot park 2718 availability for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13 (W/E types $83.25, FHU $93.55, Big Rig $103.88 averagePricePerNight), read 2026-10-22

values.note: AAA, Good Sam and active military 10% (one discount per site), by promo code at checkout.

discounts.source: https://www.mmrvpark.com/rv-sites ('AAA, Good Sam and Active Military discounts of 10% are applied at the time of reservation. Only one discount per site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: On US-2 at Hungry Horse, near Glacier NP's west entrance; wooded sites nestled among pines. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot: confirmed full hookups (now 50-amp), Campspot booking, Good Sam and military discounts (derived values now verified); added 56 sites to 45 ft with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/WiFi, season May 1 - Oct 1, fees $75-95 (Campspot 2027 quotes agree). Base $75 is over the $50 gate but Glacier NP is 13 km away (gateways.py), so no gate flag. Note trimmed of the restated rates, booking and RV Life rating.
